items.headline: UiPath reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results, including $418 million revenue, $1.901 billion ARR, and its first GAAP-profitable first quarter.
UiPath announced new product and partnership momentum, including a Google Cloud Marketplace listing for IXP with Gemini as default model and the launch of "UiPath for Coding Agents."
UiPath named a Leader in Forrester Wave: Document Mining and Analytics Platforms, Q2 2026.
